themes_negative: feels like being scammed / waste of money
red_flags: Only ~7 school-specific Google reviews exist for the Valentina entity; very thin school-specific evidence.
Two of the positive 5-star reviews are demonstrably not genuine customers: one posted by the owner herself (Valentina Ramezanzadeh) and one by a competing driving school (Autorijschool BLITZ).
A negative reviewer explicitly accuses the school of planting fake 5-star reviews ('de 2 keer 5 sterren zijn van haarzelf en een andere rijschool').
Multiple specific, serious complaints: appointments cancelled, no response, exam cancelled in final week, money not refunded ('opgelicht').

The glowing 9.3-9.4 NXXT scores (Feedbackcompany 2736 reviews, nxxt.nl 435) are NETWORK-WIDE across all NXXT branches nationwide, NOT attributable to this Den Bosch/Valentina location; named instructors (Rob van Dessel, Mendel Meinema, Truus, Peter) are not based at Veldpad 19.
NXXT-aggregate reviews read as solicited bursts of generic short 5-star one-liners ('Heel fijn', 'Leuke lessen', 'Top rijschool').
review_summary: School-specific evidence is limited to ~7 Google reviews for the Valentina entity, which are mixed-to-negative: several detailed complaints about cancelled appointments, being unreachable, an exam cancelled in the final week and money not refunded, alongside a few short positive 'passed first time' notes. Crucially, two of the positive reviews were planted by the owner herself and by a competing driving school, and a customer explicitly flags this. The high 9.3-9.4 NXXT scores seen elsewhere are network-wide across all NXXT franchises, not this branch, so they should not be read as evidence for this location.
